ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Source_Entity__c, 'Modon - Egypt')), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Sold'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Reserved') ), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Available') )
